text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Umleið kl. 11:29 fór mótmælisgongan niðaneftir Whitehall, framvið Trafalgar Square, eftir Strand, framvið Aldwych og niðaneftir Kingsway móti Holborn, har konservativi flokkurin helt sítt várting í Grand Connaught Rooms hotellinum.

text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Summi meina, harímillum John Grant, at bæði avgerandi stuðul og ein broyting í filosofiini um lærandi sjónvarp, var við til at enda røðina.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Ódnin, stødd umleið 1040 km vestanfyri Grønhøvdaoyggjar, verður ivaleyst upployst áðrenn hon hóttir nakað landsumráði, siga veðurvánirnar.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Fred hevur í løtuni havt hvirlur upp í 165 km/t og ferðast í útnyrðing.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred er sterkasta tropiska meldurhvirlan, sum nakrantíð er skrásett so langt suðuri og eysturi í Atlantshavinum, síðan mann er farin at taka fylgisveinamyndir, og bara tann triðja stóra ódnin, sum er skrásett eystan fyri 35°E.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: 24. september 1759 skrivaði Arthur Guinness undir eitt 9.000 ára leigumál fyri St James’ Gate Brewery í Dublin, Írlandi.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, annar bilførari fyri A1GP toymið í Nýsælandi, skrivaði søgu í dag, við at koyra skjótast - lógliga - um 48-ára gomlu Auckland Harbour brúnna, í Nýsælandi.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Harra Reid megnaði at koyra nýsælendska A1GP bilin Black Beauty við eini ferð yvir 160 km/t um brúnna sjey ferðir.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Nýsælendska løgreglan hevði stríð við at nýta sínar ferðmálarar at síggja, hvussu skjótt harra Reid feraðist, av tí at Black Beauty er so lágur, og einasta ferðin løgreglan megnaði at mála hjá harra Reid var, tá ið hann lækkaði ferðina til 160 km/t.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Í seinastu 3 mánaðunum vórðu yvir 80 handtikin leyslatin frá Central Booking støðini uttan at verða formliga ákærd.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Í Apríl í ár var eitt fyribils bann útflýggjað av Glynn dómara fyri støðina, fyri at noyða teimum at leyslata tey, sum vórðu handtikin yvir 24 tímar eftir teirra inntøku, uttan at fáa eina hoyring av einum rættarhjáseta.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Hjásetin setur veðhald, um tað er játtað, og fær formliga í rættlag ákærurnar, sum eru lætnar inn av løgreglumanninum, sum gjørdi handtøkuna. Ákærurnar verða síðan skrásettar í telduskipanini hjá landinum, har sakarmálið verður fylgt.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Hoyringin dagfestir eisini dagin fyri rættin hjá persóninum undir illgruna til eina skjóta dómsviðgerð.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Harra Costello segði, at tá ið kjarnorkuframleiðsla verður fíggjarliga lívfør, átti Avstralia at miða eftir hennara nýtslu.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: “Verður tað kommersielt, áttu vit at havt tað. Altso, har er í prinsippinum einki, sum talar móti kjarnorku” segði harra Costello.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Sambært Ansa, “var løgreglan stúrin um morðini á nøkur oddafólk og óttaðist, at hetta kundi eggja til ófrið í sambandi við arvafylgjuna.
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: Forstjóri Steve Jobs í Apple avdúkaði eindina við at fara á pallin og taka iPhone’ina úr sínum buksulumma.
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Upprunaliga lógaruppskotið varð gjørt av fyrrverandi borgarstjóranum í São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. Uppskotið um at løggilda, aftaná tað varð broytt, er nú í hondunum á Roberto Jefferson.
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Mótmælisfólk vóna at savna eitt skriv við 1,2 milliónir undirskriftum, at leggja fram fyri landskongressina í november.
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Aftaná tað gjørdist eyðsæð at nógvar familjur leitaðu sær løgfrøðiliga hjálp til at stríðast móti útsetingunum, varð ein fundur hildin fyri ofrini fyri bústaðarsvikinum 20. mars í East Bay Community Law Center.
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Tá ið leigararnar byrjaðu at greiða frá, hvat teir høvdu verið fyri, varnaðust tær flestu innblandaðu familjurnar, at Carolyn Wilson frá OHA hevði stolið teirra trygdargjøld og var rýmd úr býnum.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Kendu griksku løgfrøðingarnir, Sakis Kechagioglou og George Nikolakopoulos eru fongslaðir í Korydallus fongslinum í Athen, av tí at teir vórðu dømdir sekir í sviki og mutri.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Tískil er ein stór gøla komin í grikska løgfrøðiliga felagsskapinum av, at ólógligt virksemið, framt av dómarum, løgfrøðingum og sakførarum gjøgnum undanfarnu árini, er avdúkað.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Harafturat er Evangelos Kalousis yvirdómari fongslaður, av tí at hann varð dømdur sekur í mutri og spiltum atburði.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts noktaði bart út at siga, nær hann meinar, lív byrjar, ein týdningarmikil spurningur í kjakinum um etikkin í fosturtøku, og segði at tað ikki hevði verið etiskt at viðmerkja smálutir frá sannlíkum dømum.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Kortini tók hann sína frágreiðing uppaftur, sum hann áður gav, um at Roe v. Wade var “óvikandi lógin í landinum”, og undirstrikaði týdningin av samsvarandi úrskurðum í hægstirættinum.
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: Hann váttaði eisini at hann trúði upp á treytaða rættin til privatlív, sum Roe avgerðin var treytað av.
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Maroochydore gjørdist liðugur ovast á stiganum, seks stig framman fyri Noosa á øðrum plássi.

text: Báðar síðurnar vildu møtast í størru hálvfinaluni, har Noosa vann við 11 stigum.

text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Eftir fleiri hundrað tímar í gongd, brennur glóðtráðurin í peruni at enda út og ljósperan riggar ikki meir.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Síðan má ljósperan skiftast út. Tað er neyðugt at vísa ansni, tá ið ljósperan verður skift út.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Fyrst má avbrótarin til ljósútgerðina brótast av ella leidningurin takast úr.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Hetta er av tí at ravmagn streymar inn í úttakið, har metalparturin av peruni situr og kann geva tær ein álvarsaman stoyt gjøgnum úttakið ella metalpartin av peruni, meðan hann enn er partvís í úttakinum.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Størsta yrkisgagnið í blóðrenslinum er hjartað, sum pumpar blóðið.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Blóðið fer úr hjartanum í rørum, sum nevnast lívæðrar, og kemur aftur í rørum, sum nevnast bláæðrar. Minstu rørini nevnast háræðrar.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Tenninar hjá triceraptorinum høvdu verið førar fyri ikki bara at knúsa bløð, men enntá eisini seigar greinar og røtur.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Summi vísindafólk halda at triceraptorar ótu cykasplantur, sum eru eitt plantuslag, sum var vanligt í krittíðini.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Hesar planturnar líkjast einum lítlum pálmatræi við eini krúnu við hvøssum, spískum bløðum.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Ein triceraptor hevði verið førur fyri at nýta sítt sterka nev til at skræða bløðini av, áðrenn hann át bulin.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Onnur vísindafólk vísa á, at hesar planturnar eru sera eitrandi, so tað er ikki sannlíkt, at nakar dinosaurur át tær, hóast letidýrið og onnur djór, t.d. pappageykurin (ein eftirkomari hjá dinosaurunum), kunnu eta eitrandi bløð og fruktir í dag.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Hvussu hevði tyngdarmegin hjá Io drigið meg? Um tú stóð á yvirflatuni á Io, hevði tú vigað minni, enn tú gert á jørðini.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Eitt fólk sum vigar 90 kg á jørðini hevði vigað umleið 116 kg á Io. So tyngdarmegin dregur sjálvandi minni í teg.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Sólin hevur ikki eina skorpu eins og jørðin, sum tú kanst standa á. Øll sólin er gjørd úr gassum, eldi og plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Gassið verður tynri tess longri tú kemur frá miðjuni av sólini.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Uttari parturin, sum vit síggja, tá ið vit hyggja at sólini, verður nevndur ljóshválvið, sum merkir “kúla við ljósi”.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Umleið trítúsund ár seinni, í 1610, brúkti italski stjørnufrøðingurin Galileo Galilei ein stjørnukikara at eygleiða, hvussu Venus hevur skifti, eins og mánin hevur.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Skifti koma, tí bara ein síða av Venus (ella av mánanum), sum vendir móti sólini verður lýst á. Skiftini hjá Venus stuðla undir ástøðið hjá Copernicus, um at gongustjørnurnar ferðast kring sólina.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Nøkur fá ár seinni í 1639 eygleiddi ein enskur stjørnufrøðingur, sum æt Jeremiah Horrocks, eina Venus tvørgongd.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Ongland hevði upplivað eitt langt tíðarskeið við friði eftir endurhertøkuna av Danalagnum.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Men í 991 stóð Ethelred fyri einum víkingaflota, størri enn nakar annar síðan flotan hjá Guthrumi ein øld frammanundan.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Flotin var leiddur av Ólavi Trygvasyni, ein norðmaður við máli um at vinna land sítt aftur úr donskum valdi.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Eftir innleiðandi hernaðarlig afturstig kláraði Ethelred at koma til sættis við Ólav, sum fór aftur til Noregs fyri at royna at vinna sítt ríki við ivasamum úrsliti.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul er einasta stavraðið í vanligum gerandisbrúki, sum er gjørt til endamálið. Stavraðið varð uppfunnið í 1444 undir stýrinum hjá Sejong kongi (1418 – 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Sejong kongur var fjórði kongurin í Joseon kongsættini og er ein av teimum mest virdu.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: At byrja við kallaði hann Hangeul-stavraðið Hunmin Jeongeum, sum merkir “røttu ljóðini til at leiðbeina fólkið”.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Nógv ástøði eru til, um hvussu sanskrift varð til. Eitt av teimum er um eina ariska flyting úr vestri til India, sum tók sítt mál við sær.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrift er eitt fyrndargamalt mál og kann samanberast við latínska málið, sum varð talað í Evropa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Fyrsta bókin í verðini, sum veitst um, varð skrivað við sanskrift. Eftir upanisad-tekstirnir vóru savnaðir saman, fánaði sanskrift burtur vegna átrúnaðarligt veldi.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrift er eitt sera fjøltáttað og ríkt mál, sum hevur verið uppruni til nógv nýggj indisk mál, eins og latín hevur verið uppruni til evropeisk mál, sum t.d. franskt og spanskt.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Nú bardagin um Frakland var av, byrjaði Týskland at fyrireika seg til at gera innrás í oynna Bretland.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Týskland gav álopið loyninavnið “Sealion tiltakið”. Meginparturin av góðu vápnunum og útgerðini hjá bretska herinum varð mist burtur, tá ið hann rýmdi úr Dunkirk, so herurin var heldur veikur.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Men kongaligi herflotin var enn nógv sterkari enn týski herflotin (“Kriegsmarine”) og hevði kunnað týnt ein og hvønn flota, sum varð sendur um Ermarsund.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Tó vóru fá skip í kongaliga herflotanum sett nær við sannlíku leiðirnar fyri álop, tí herflotaovastar vóru óttaðust fyri, at týsk flogálop fóru at søkka tey.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Latið okkum byrja við eini frágreiðing um ætlanirnar hjá Italia. Italia var fyrst og fremst “lítlibeiggi” Týsklands og Japans.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Tað hevði ein veikari her og ein veikari herflota, hóast tey júst høvdu bygt fýra nýggj skip beint undan byrjanini á krígnum.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Høvðusmálini hjá Italia vóru afrikansk lond. Fyri at hertaka tey londini, tørvaðu teimum ein skotpall til eindir, so eindir kundu sigla um Miðjarðarhavið og gera innrás í Afrika.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Til tess, máttu tey koma av við bretskar støðir og skip í Egyptalandi. Umframt hesir bardagarnir, vóru herskipini hjá Italia ikki ætlað at gera nakað annað.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Og nú Japan. Japan var eitt oyggjaland, eins og Bretland.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Kavbátar eru skip, sum eru sniðgivin til at ferðast undirsjóvar og at vera har í eitt longri tíðarskeið.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Kavbátar vóru nýttir í fyrra og seinna heimsbardaga. Tá í tíðini vóru teir sera seinir og høvdu ein sera avmarkaðan skotmála.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Í byrjanini av krígnum ferðaðust teir mest oman á sjónum, men so hvørt sum radarar vórðu mentir og gjørdust meira neyvir, noyddust kavbátarnir at fara undir vatn fyri ikki at verða sæddir.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Týskir kavbátar itu U-Bátar. Týskarar dugdu væl at stýra og røkja sínar kavbátar.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Tí teir høvdu so góða eydnu við kavbátum, sleppa týskarar ikki at eiga nógvar eftir kríggið.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Ja! Tutankhamun kongur, viðhvørt umrøddur sum “Tut kongur” ella “Dreingjakongurin”, er í nútíðini ein tann kendasti egyptiski kongurin frá fornari tíð.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Tað er áhugavert, at hann ikki var mettur at vera serliga týdningarmikil í forðum og varð ikki skrásettur í elstu yvirlitunum yvir kongar.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Men tá ið grøv hansara varð uppdagað í 1922, gjørdist hann víðagitin. Meðan nógvar gravir frá fortíðini vórðu rændar, var hendan grøvin heilt órørd.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Flestu lutirnir, sum vóru grivnir niður saman við Tutankhamun, eru væl varðveittir, harímillum fornlutir í túsundatali gjørdir úr dýrabarum málmi og sjáldsomum gimsteinum.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Uppfinningin av snælduhjólinum gjørdi assýriskar vognar lættari, skjótari og betri fyrireikaðir til at koyra frá hermonnum og øðrum vognum.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Pílar frá drepandi lásbogunum kundi skjótast gjøgnum brynjuna hjá fíggindahermonnum. Umleið ár 1000 f.Kr. innførdu assýrar fyrsta reiðliðið.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Eitt reiðlið er ein herur, sum stríðist á rossabaki. Saðilin var enn ikki uppfunnin, so assýriska reiðliðið stríddist á beru ryggjunum á sínum rossum.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Vit vita um nógvar grikskar politikarar, vísindafólk og listafólk. Kanska mest kendi maðurin í hesi mentanini er Homer, sagnkendi blindi yrkjarin, sum yrkti tvey meistaraverk við grikskum bókmentum: yrkingarnar Iliadan og Odysséin.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sofokles og Aristofanes eru enn avhildin leikskald, og teirra leikir eru hildnir at vera millum størstu verkini í heimsbókmentum.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Ein annar kendur grikki er ein støddfrøðingur, Pytagoras, mest kendur fyri sín tiltikna setning um sambond millum síðurnar í einum tríhyrningi.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Ymiskar metingar eru um, hvussu nógv fólk tosa hindi. Tað verður mett at vera millum næst- og fjórðmest vanliga talaða málið í heiminum.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Talið á fólki, sum hava málið sum móðurmál, er ymiskt, treytað av antin dialektir, sum minna nógv um, verða taldar við ella ikki.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Metingar liggja millum 340 milliónir til 500 milliónir fólk, sum tosað málið, og so mikið sum 800 milliónir fólk skilja málið.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Orðatilfeingini í hindi og urdu líkjast, men skriftin er ólík; í gerandisdags samrøðum, kunnu fólk, sum tosa annað málið, vanliga skilja hvønn annan.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Í 15. øld var Norðurestland undir stórari mentanarligari ávirkan frá Týsklandi.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Nakrir týskir munkar vildu føra Gud nærri at innfødda fólkinum, so teir uppfunnu estiska skriftmálið.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Tað var grundað á týska stavraðið, og ein stavur "Õ/õ" varð lagdur afturat.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Sum frá leið, runnu nógv orð saman, sum vóru lænd úr týskum. Hetta var byrjanin upp á upplýsing.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Eftir vanligum siði fór arvingurin til trónuna beinleiðis í herin, eftir hann var liðugur í skúla.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Tó fór Charles í háskúla í Trinity College, Cambridge, har hann las mannfrøði og fornfrøði, og seinni søgu, og tók eitt 2:2 prógv (ein lágur annar floks karakterur).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles var fyrsti limurin í bretsku kongaligu familjuni, sum fekk eitt prógv.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Evropeiskt Turkaland (eystur Trakia ella Rumelia í Balkanhálvoynni) fevnir um 3% av landinum.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Turkiska økið er yvir 1.600 kilometrar langt og 800 km breitt, við einum næstan fýrhyrntum skapi.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Víddin á Turkalandi, vøtn íroknað, er 783.562 ferkilometrar, sum 755.688 ferkilometrar eru í útsynningspartinum av Asia og 23.764 ferkilometrar í Evropa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Víddin á Turkalandi ger tað til 37. størsta landið, og er til støddar umleið sum meginlands Frakland og Stórabretland tilsaman.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turkaland hevur høv á trimum síðum: Egeahavið í vesturi, Svartahavið í norðuri og Miðjarðarhavið í suðuri.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luksemborg hevur eina langa søgu, men fekk sítt frælsi í 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Nútíðar øki í Belgia vóru áður partur av Luksemborg, men gjørdust belgisk eftir belgisku kollveltingina í 1830’unum.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luksemborg hevur altíð roynt at vera eitt uttanveltað land, men var hersett av Týsklandi bæði í fyrra heimsbardaga og í seinna heimsbardaga.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Í 1957 var Luksemborg við til at stovna felagsskapin, sum í dag eitur Evropeiska Samveldið.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong er ein avtoftaður skansi og eitt buddistiskt munkakleystur í ovara partinum av Paro býlinginum (í Phondey Village).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Hildið verur, at í 1649 bygdi Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel skansan fyri at minnast sín sigur á tibetansku og mongolsku herliðunum.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Í 1951 elvdi ein eldur til, at bara nakrir fáir halgilutir frá Drukgyal Dzong vóru eftir, m.a. myndin av Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Eftir eldin varð skansin friðaður og vardur, og er enn eitt tað mest forvitnisliga ferðamálið í Butan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Í 18. øld var Kambodia kleimt millum tvey máttmikil grannalond, Tailand og Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Í 18. øld gjørdu tailendingarnir innrás í Kambodia fleiri ferðir, og í 1772 løgdu teir Phnom Phen í oyði.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Síðst í 18. øld gjørdu vietnamesarar eisini innrás í Kambodia.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Átjan prosent av venesuelum eru arbeiðsleysir, og meginparturin av teimum, sum eru í starvi, arbeiða í undirgrundarbúskapinum.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Tveir triðingar av venesuelum í starvi, arbeiða í tænastuveiting, næstan ein fjórðingur arbeiðir í ídnaði, og ein fimtingur arbeiðir í landbúnaði.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Ein týðandi ídnaður hjá venesuelum er olja, landið er ein nettoútflytari, hóast bara eitt prosent arbeiðir í oljuídnaðinum.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Stutt eftir at tjóðin fekk sjálvstýri, hjálpti Singapore Botanic Gardens, við sínum serkunnleika, at gera oynna til ein tropiskan urtagarðsbý.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Í 1981 varð Vanda Miss Joaquim, ein kynblandað orkide, vald at vera tjóðblóma í tjóðini.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Hvørt ár í oktober, tá regntíðin byrjar, ferðast næstan 1,5 milliónir plantuátarar úr fjallalendinum í norðuri, yvir um Maraánna móti slættlendinum í suðuri.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Og norður aftur úr vestri, yvir um Maraánna aftur, eftir regntíðina í Apríl.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikkisma er ein átrúnaður frá indiska hálvmeginlandinum. Hon stavar frá einum sekteriskum klovningi í hinduistisku siðvenjuni í landspartinum Punjab í 15. øld.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Sikkar meta teirra trúgv at vera ein átrúnaður ymiskur frá hinduismu, hóast teir viðurkenna, at hann hevur hinduistiskar røtur og siðvenju.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Átrúnaðurin varð grundaður í 15. øld av Guru Nanak (1469-1539). Ein arvarað fylgdi við níggju øðrum guruum.

text: Í einum vanligum umfari, eru átjan hol, har leikarar vanliga byrja við fyrsta holinum á breytini og enda við átjanda holinum.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Leikarin, sum nýtir fæst sløg, ella skot við kylvuni, at klára breytina, hevur vunnið.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Spælið gongur fyri seg á grasi, og grasið kring holið verður sligið styttri og kallast flata.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Vanligasta slagið av ferðavinnu, er mátin, sum tey flestu seta í samband við at ferðast: Frítíðarferðavinna.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Hetta er, tá ið fólk ferðast til eitt stað, sum er øðrvísi enn teirra vanliga lív, fyri at hvíla sær og stuttleika sær.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Strendur, undirhaldsgarðar og legupláss eru ofta tey vanligastu støðini, sum frítíðarferðafólk vitja.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Um endamálið við ferðini til eitt ávíst stað er at læra um søguna og mentanina, verður hetta slagið av ferðavinnu nevnt mentanarferðavinna.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Ferðafólk vitja kanska ymisk staðarmerki í einum ávísum landi, ella velja bara at hugsavna seg um eitt umráði.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Tá ið niðursetumenninir sóu hetta virksemið, bóðu teir eisini um nýggjar hermenn.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Eindirnar, sum styrktu støðuna frammarlaga, vóru m.a. fyrsti og triði herflokkurin úr New Hampshire við 200 monnum, undir oberstunum John Stark og James Reed (báðir vórðu seinni generalar).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Menninir hjá Stark tóku støðu fram við hegnið norðanfyri støðuna hjá niðursetumonnunum.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Tá ið fjøran gjørdi eitt glopp fram við Mystic River í landnyrðingspartinum av hálvoynni, longdu teir kvikliga hegnið við einum stuttum steinmúri norðureftir, sum endaði við sjóvarmálan á eini lítlari strond.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley ella Stark legði ein staka, umleið 30 m til longdar, frammanfyri hegnið, og gav boð um, at eingin mátti skjóta, fyrr enn teir vandu hermenninir vóru komnir yvirum.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Amerikanska ætlanin var bundin at at gera samskipað álop frá trimum ymiskum síðum.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: John Cadwalder generalur gjørdi eitt fráleiðingarálop á bretsku hermannaleguna í Bordentown, fyri at forða nýggjum hermonnum í at koma fram.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: James Ewing generalur flutti 700 varnarhermenn yvirum ánna við Trenton Ferry, tók brúnna um Assunpink Creek og forðaði fíggindahermonnum í at flíggja.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Størsta snarálopsherliðið við 2.400 monnum fór yvirum ánna níggju míl norðanfyri Trenton, og fór síðan sundur í tvey lið, eitt undir Greene og eitt undir Sullivan, fyri at gera eitt álop áðrenn dimmalætting.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Í mun til eina 400-m kapprenning, er ferð í eini 800-m kapprenning av minni týdningi, og úthaldni er nógv meira avgerandi.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Sjálvandi noyðist ein framúrskarandi 800-m rennari, ein maður sum klárar at renna teinin upp á minni enn tveir minuttir, at hava eina góða ferð, men tað er altavgerandi, at hann mennir úthaldni.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Víðavangskappingar um veturin, saman við fimleikavenjingar fyri yvirkroppin, er besta fyrireikingin til rennisesongina.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Hóskandi kostvanar kunnu ikki í sær sjálvum elva til framúrskarandi útinning, men teir kunnu, sum heild, ávirka heilsuna hjá ungum ítróttarfólkum munandi.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Ítróttarfólk, sum varðveita ein heilsugóðan orkujavna, hava góðar vanar við at inntaka vesku, og skilja ymisku síðurnar av at taka kostískoyti, kunnu betra um sína útinning og økja um teirra gleði við ítróttin.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Miðrenning er ein lutfalsliga bíligur ítróttur; tó eru nakrar misskiljingar viðvíkjandi fáu lutirnar í útgerðini, sum er neyðug fyri at luttaka.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Tað ber til at keypa vørurnar eftir tørvi, men tær flestu hava lítla ella onga avgerandi ávirkan á útinningina.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Ítróttarfólk halda kanska, at teimum dáma onkra vøru betur, hóast hon ikki gevur nakran serligan fyrimun.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Atomið kann metast at vera ein teir mest grundleggjandi byggisteinarnir av øllum evnistilfari.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Tað er ein sera samansett heild, sum, eftir einum einfaldum Bohr myndli, hevur ein kjarna í miðjuni, og elektronir, sum ganga í ringrás um hann, nakað líknandi gongustjørnum, sum ferðast um sólina - sí Mynd 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Kjarnin hevur tveir bitlar - nevtrónir og protónir.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Protónir hava eina positiva ravmagnsløðing, meðan nevtrónir onga løðing hava. Elektrónirnar hava eina negativa ravmagnsløðing.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Fyri at kanna tann løstaða, mást tú meta um støðuna, fyri at tryggja tær tín egna tryggleika.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Tú mást geva støðuna hjá tí løstaða gætur, tá ið tú nærkast honum ella henni, og varnast eyðsýnd vandatekin.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Um tú verður løstaður, meðan tú roynir at hjálpa, fer tað kanska bara at gera støðuna verri.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Kanningin vísti at tunglyndi, ótti og at meta støðuna, sum ein stór vanlukka, hekk saman við sambandið millum pínu og avlamni hjá sjúklingum við pínu um lendarnar.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Fyri at fáa eina skipaða PA-viðgerð hvørja viku var treytin, at mann hevði árin av vanlukkuhugsan, meðan tunglyndi og ótti ikki var fevnt av hesari treyt.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Tey, sum vóru við í regluligum virksemi, høvdu tørv á meira hjálp við negativari áskoðan á pínu og at læra at skyna millum kroniska pínu, ella óróskenslu og vanliga kropsliga rørslu.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Sjónin, ella førleikin at síggja, er tengd at sjónarsansingargøgnunum ella eygunum.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Eygu hava nógvar ymiskar uppbyggingar, sum hava ymiska samanseting, alt eftir hvørjum veran hevur tørv á.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Ymisku uppbyggingarnar hava ymiskar eginleikar, varnast ymiskar bylgjulongdir og hava ymisk mál av gløggleika, tað er, at tað, sum kemur inn verður viðgjørt á ymiskan hátt, og ymisk tøl eru neyðug fyri at tær kunnu virka best.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Ein stovnur er fleiri verur av einum slagi, sum eru savnaðar í einum ávísum landafrøðiligum øki.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Tá ið tær einstøku verurnar í einum stovni eru líkar í mun til ein ávísan framkomuskapligan eginleika, eru tær einskapaðar.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Tá ið einstøku verurnar hava ymisk sløg av einum ávísum eginleika, eru tær fjølskapaðar.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Hermeyrutúgvur marsjera og reiðrast eisini í ymiskum skeiðum.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Í umfarasskeiðinum marsjera hermeyrurnar um náttina og steðga fyri at hvíla um dagin.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Túgvan byrjar sítt umfarsskeið, tá ið maturin, sum er til taks, minkar. Í hesum skeiðinum ger túgvan fyribils reiður, sum verða broytt hvønn dag.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Hvør av hesum umfarandi herverkunum ella marsjunum taka umleið 17 dagar.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Hvat er ein kykna? Enska orðið fyri kykna (cell) stavar frá latínska orðinum “cella”, sum merkir “lítið rúm”, og tað var ein sjóneykumaður, sum fyrst brúkti tað, tá ið hann eygleiddi bygnaðin í tundri.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Kyknan er grundleggjandi tilfarið í øllum livandi verum, og allar verur hava minst eina ella fleiri kyknur.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Kyknur eru so grundleggjandi og avgerandi í lívfrøði, at tær ofta verða nevndar “lívsins byggisteinar”.
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Nervalagið varðveitir javnstøðuhaldið við at senda nervaimpulsar gjøgnum kroppin fyri at lata blóðið floyma runt uttan at verða órógvað nógv.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Hesir nervaimpulsarnir kunnu sendast skjótt gjøgnum kroppin, sum hjálpir kroppinum at verja seg móti hugsandi hóttanum.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Melduródnir raka eitt lítið øki, samanborið við aðrar ógvusligar ódnir, men tær kunnu leggja alt á síni leið í oyði.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Melduródnir ríva trø upp við rót, skræða fjalir av bygningum og syfta bilar upp í luftina. Tvey prosent av melduródnunum, sum teljast millum tær ógvisligastu, vara meira enn tríggjar tímar.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Í hesum ræðuligu ódnunum, kann vindurin koma upp í 480 km/t (133 m/s).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Menniskjan hevur framleitt og brúkt linsur at størka við í fleiri túsund ár.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Kortini vórðu teir fyrstu rættiligu kikararnar bygdir í Evropa seint í 16. øld.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Hesir kikararnir vórðu samansettir av tveimum linsum, sum fingu lutir langt burtur at tykjast nærri og størri.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Girnd og sjálvsøkni fara altíð at vera partar av okkum, og í sambandi við samstarv er tað ein náttúrulóg, at um meginparturin fær nakað gott burtur úr, fer ein sjálvsøkin atburður altíð at gagna stuttskygt.

text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Nógv droyma, um tann dagin menniskju kunnu ferðast til eina aðra stjørnu og rannsaka aðrar heimar, summi hugsa um, hvat er har úti, og summi halda, at rúmdarverur ella annað lív kanska eru at finna á øðrum gongustjørnum.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Men um hetta nakrantíð fer at henda, fer tað helst ikki at henda fyrr enn um ógvuliga langa tíð. Stjørnurnar eru so langt burtur frá hvørjari aðrari, at har eru fleiri billiónir kilometrar millum “grannastjørnur”.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Kanska standa tíni langabba - ella langommubørn ein dagin í einum fremmandum heimi og hugsa um sínar forfedrar úr farnari tíð.
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Djór eru gjørd burtur úr nógvum kyknum. Tey eta ting og sodna tey innaní. Tey flestu djórini kunnu røra seg.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Har eru djór allastaðni á jørðini. Tey grava í jørðini, svimja í høvunum og flúgva í luftini.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Ein kykna er minsta bygnaðar- og virkiseindin í livandi (tingum) verum.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Enska orðið fyri kykna (cell) kemur frá latínska orðinum cella, sum merkir lítið rúm.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Hyggur tú at livandi verum gjøgnum eina sjóneyku, sært tú, at tær eru gjørdar burtur úr smáum terningum ella kúlum.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Køvievni hevur sum gass somu eginleikar sum flótandi køvievni. Flótandi støðan er fastari, men mýlini eru tey somu.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Vatn er eitt annað dømi. Vatnsambandið er gjørt úr tveimum vatnevnisatomum og einum súrevnisatomi.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Tað hevur sama mýlska bygnaðin, antin tað er gass, flótandi ella fast.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Hóast alisfrøðiliga støðan kanska broytist, er evnafrøðiliga støðan tann sama.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Tíðin er rundan um okkum og ávirkar alt vit fáast við, men hon er torfør at fáa greiðu á.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Átrúnaðarligir, heimspekiligir og vísindaligir lærdir hava granskað tíð í fleiri túsund ár.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Vit uppliva tíðina sum eina røð av hendingum, sum fara fram frá framtíðini gjøgnum nútíðina til fortíðina.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Vit samanbera eisini tíðarbilið (longdina) á hendingum við tíð.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Tú kanst sjálvur marka, hvussu tíðin líður, við at eygleiða endurtakandi hendingar, sum fara í ring. Hendingar, sum fara í ring, eru okkurt, sum regluliga hendir umaftur og umaftur.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Teldur í dag eru nýttar at viðgera myndir og sjónfílur.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Framkomnar teldur upptaka ofta tónleik fyri at viðgera og blanda ljóð saman.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Í nítjandu og tjúgundu øld, hildu fólk í langa tíð, at maori, sum veiddi stórar fuglar, nevndir moa, vóru fyrstu íbúgvarnar í Nýsælandi.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Ástøðið setti síðani hugskotið upp, at maori ferðaðist úr Polynesia á einum stórum flaka og tóku Nýsæland frá moriori, og stovnaðu eitt landbúnaðarsamfelag.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Samanberandi hugsunarmynstur eru problemloysandi teknikkir, sum sameina ymiskar hugsanir ella øki fyri at finna eina loysn.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Endamálið við hesum hugsunarháttinum er ferð, logikkur og neyvleiki, eisini at eyðmerkja faktum, endurnýta verandi mannagongdir og savna inn upplýsingar.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Fólk við hesum slagnum av hugsan hava logiska hugsan, og eru før fyri at læra mynstur uttan at, loysa trupulleikar og arbeiða við vísindarligum kanningum.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: MRI tekur støði í einum alisfrøðiligum fyribrigdi, sum eitur kjarnamagnetiskt viðsveiggj (KMV), sum Felix Bloch (við starvi í Stanford University) og Edward Purcell (úr Harvard University) varnaðust í 1930’unum.
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Í hesum viðsveigginum, fáa magnetiskt øki og radiobylgjur atom til at geva smá radiosignal frá sær.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Fýra ár seinni varð eitt patent givið, sum var heimsins fyrsta patent í økinum innanfyri MRI.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Í 1977 varð Damadian lækni liðugur at byggja fyrsta MRI-skannaran til allan kroppin, sum hann kallaði “Indomitable”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Óstevjavnað samskifti stuðlar til at nýta tíð til at grunda og svara øðrum aftur.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Undirsjóvar ljósleiðarakáplar til Evropa og breiðbandsfylgisveinar gera, at Grønland hevur gott samband til 93% av íbúgvunum, sum hava netsamband.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.
